scope: Re-accept implemented features before further phases; local isolated fixtures, no production writes.

scenarios: all four 120-second scenario timelines, 7201 samples each
desktop/mobile all four studio scenarios and five shots
social dialogue six turns, reload and camera
city tag, bike, pets, homes, gardens and domain skills
browser: current G0 pixel budget, transport, pause/network failures and recovery
overlays/households, interiors, action clips, resource gallery, sound lifecycle
shared ground two viewers and clock sampling
learning: fresh frozen synthetic runtime policy benchmark
fresh preregistered H1 rollout/comparison where inputs available
audit H2/H4/H6/H10 negative decisions and frozen evidence without tuning or opening reserved H10 holdout
operations: local loopback only, all mutations isolated
artifact/source provenance and production ledger reconciliation

rules: Record command, source, exit status, elapsed time and log hashes; preserve failures and reruns.
Fix actual defects, do not weaken assertions just to pass. Superseded expectations require documented current contract and equivalent assertions.
No live DB reset/migration, no paid inference/GPU, no duplicate automation, no candidate promotion.
Historical evidence audits are not fresh inference or a fresh controlled study.
Browser synthetic/SwiftShader results are not production, hardware FPS, 24-hour liveness, semantic quality or model training.
Production acceptance requires native deployment/database/scheduler tools; absence is a blocker, never a pass.
